title: PSLE (Singapore)
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the public PSLE syllabus. Not a capture of past exam questions.

items.stem: Read the sentence. The children were elated when the school announced an extra day of holiday. What does elated mean as used in the sentence?
items.explanation: An extra holiday is good news, and elated describes a feeling of great joy, so extremely happy is the only meaning that fits the context.

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct verb. Neither the class monitor nor the prefects ____ informed about the change of venue for the assembly.
items.explanation: With neither ... nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, and prefects is plural, so were is the only correct choice.

items.stem: Join the two sentences with the connector so that. Jalan kept his promise to his mother. He did not want to disappoint her.
options: Jalan kept his promise to his mother so that he would not disappoint her.
Jalan did not want to disappoint her so that he broke his promise.
Jalan kept his promise to his mother although he did not want to disappoint her.
Jalan kept his promise because he had already disappointed her.
items.explanation: So that introduces the purpose of an action, and Jalan kept the promise in order not to disappoint his mother, which only the third sentence states.

items.stem: Read the passage. Every morning Grandfather swept the fallen leaves from the front yard, even though the wind scattered them again by noon. He said the yard taught him to begin again without complaint. What does the passage suggest about Grandfather?
options: He is impatient with household chores
He wants to frighten the wind away
He hopes the neighbours will sweep the yard for him
He accepts hard work that must be repeated, without complaining
items.explanation: Grandfather sweeps knowing the wind will scatter the leaves again, and he speaks of beginning again without complaint, which shows patient acceptance of repeated work.

items.stem: Choose the word opposite in meaning to generous as used in this sentence. The generous donor gave half of her savings to the school fund.
items.explanation: Generous means willing to give freely, so stingy, meaning unwilling to give, is its opposite, while kind, wealthy and friendly are not opposites of it.

items.stem: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
options: The girls bags were left in the corridor.
The girls bags' were left in the corridor.
The girls' bags were left in the corridor.
The girls,bags were left in the corridor.
items.explanation: The bags belong to more than one girl, so the apostrophe must come after the s in girls, which makes the second sentence the correctly punctuated one.

items.stem: Which sentence below contains an error in subject-verb agreement?
options: Each of the boys has brought his own calculator.
Neither of the answers is correct.
Each of the boys have brought their own calculator.
Everyone in the team is ready for the quiz.
items.explanation: Each is a singular subject and takes the singular verb has, so the third sentence disagrees, while the other three sentences are all correct.

items.stem: What does the expression time flies suggest in this sentence? The old schoolmates laughed and agreed that time flies since the day they last met.
options: Insects are a problem in that season
The clock in the school hall is broken
The holidays are far too short
items.explanation: Time flies is an idiom meaning that time seems to pass very quickly, which fits the schoolmates noticing how long ago they last met.

items.stem: Siti placed the trophy on the top shelf because she wanted to keep it safe overnight. What does the word it in the sentence refer to?
items.explanation: It is the thing being placed and kept safe, so it refers to the trophy, since a shelf cannot keep itself safe and the other nouns do not fit the meaning.

items.stem: You are writing to your school principal to ask for a recycling corner in the canteen. Which opening sentence is most suitable for a formal letter?
options: Hey principal, can we get some bins in the canteen?
The canteen smells and nobody bothers to recycle anything.
I am writing to propose that a recycling corner be set up in the canteen.
Recycling is dull, but the teacher told us to write this letter.
items.explanation: A formal letter to a principal needs a polite, purposeful opening, and only the second sentence states the request in a respectful and formal register.

items.stem: Identify the adverb in this sentence. The excited children laughed loudly at the clown's clever tricks.
items.explanation: Loudly tells us how the children laughed, which is the work of an adverb, while excited and clever describe nouns and children names the doer of the action.

items.stem: The doctor was sanguine about the patient's recovery and told the family that the worst had passed. As used here, the word sanguine means
items.explanation: The doctor reassures the family that the worst is over, so sanguine must mean positive and hopeful about the outcome rather than uncertain or indifferent.

items.stem: Read the sentence. Although the market was noisy, Priya concentrated on her spelling list and scored full marks in the test. What does the word although show?
options: The time of day when the test was held
A reason why the market was noisy
An addition to the list of spelling words
A contrast between the noise and her concentration
items.explanation: Although sets two ideas against each other, so it contrasts the noisy market with Priya's ability to concentrate and still score full marks.

items.stem: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence. Of the three recipes tested in the cooking lesson, grandmother's is the ____ because it needs the fewest steps.
items.explanation: Three recipes are being compared, which calls for the superlative form, so simplest is correct, while simpler and more simple are comparative forms.

items.stem: Which sentence shows the correct way to punctuate direct speech?
options: “I have finished my project,” said Huda proudly.
I have finished my project, said Huda proudly.
“I have finished my project” said Huda, proudly.
“I have finished my project,” Said Huda proudly.
items.explanation: Direct speech must sit inside quotation marks with a comma before the closing quote and a lowercase reporting verb, which only the second sentence does.

items.stem: The ratio of red marbles to blue marbles in a bag is 3 to 5. There are 40 marbles in the bag altogether. How many red marbles are there?
items.explanation: The ratio gives 8 equal parts for 40 marbles, so each part is 5 marbles and the red share of 3 parts is 15 marbles.

items.stem: A shirt marked at $48 is sold at a discount of 25 percent. What is the discounted price of the shirt?
items.explanation: A 25 percent discount takes away a quarter of $48, which is $12, so the customer pays $48 minus $12, giving $36.

items.stem: A cyclist travels at a constant speed of 12 km/h. How far does he travel in 2.5 hours?
items.explanation: Distance equals speed multiplied by time, so 12 km/h multiplied by 2.5 hours gives a distance of 30 km.

items.stem: Work out the value of 3/4 divided by 1/2 and give your answer as a mixed number.
items.explanation: Dividing by one half means multiplying by two, and 3/4 multiplied by 2 gives 6/4, which simplifies to the mixed number 1 1/2.

items.stem: What is the total when 0.7, 0.08 and 0.009 are added together?
items.explanation: Writing each value with three decimal places gives 0.700 plus 0.080 plus 0.009 equals 0.789, and the other totals come from misplacing the decimal points.

items.stem: A rectangular classroom measures 15 m by 9 m. What is the area of the classroom floor?
items.explanation: The area of a rectangle is length times width, so 15 m multiplied by 9 m gives 135 m2, while 48 m is the perimeter of the same rectangle.

items.stem: Solve the equation 3n + 7 = 25. What is the value of n?
items.explanation: Subtracting 7 from both sides gives 3n equals 18, and dividing both sides by 3 shows that n equals 6.

items.stem: Siti and Ah Ming have $110 altogether. Ah Ming has $20 more than Siti. How much does Siti have?
items.explanation: If Siti has one share, Ah Ming has the same share plus $20, so two shares equal $90 and Siti's share is $45.

items.stem: The school gardening club had 40 pupils. Ten more pupils joined the following week. What was the percentage increase in membership?
items.explanation: The increase of 10 pupils is compared with the original 40, and 10 divided by 40 equals one quarter, which is a 25 percent increase.

items.stem: A rectangular box has a length of 10 cm, a width of 5 cm and a height of 4 cm. What is its volume?
items.explanation: The volume of a cuboid is length times width times height, so 10 times 5 times 4 gives 200 cm3, while 19 cm3 merely adds the three dimensions together.

items.stem: The average of four test scores is 75. After a fifth score is included, the average of all five scores becomes 78. What is the fifth score?
items.explanation: Four scores averaging 75 give a total of 300, and five scores averaging 78 give a total of 390, so the fifth score is 390 minus 300, which is 90.

items.stem: One third of a number is 24. What is one half of the same number?
items.explanation: If one third of the number is 24, then the whole number is 24 multiplied by 3, which is 72, and one half of 72 is 36.

items.stem: Two angles of a triangle measure 65 degrees and 48 degrees. What is the size of the third angle?
items.explanation: The angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees, and 180 minus 65 minus 48 leaves 67 degrees for the third angle.

items.stem: A ribbon 3.6 m long is cut into equal pieces each 0.45 m long. How many pieces are obtained?
items.explanation: The number of pieces is the total length divided by the length of each piece, and 3.6 divided by 0.45 gives 8 pieces.

items.stem: Mr Tan saved $250 and spent 12 percent of his savings on groceries. How much of his savings was left?
items.explanation: Twelve percent of $250 is $30, so the amount left is $250 minus $30, which is $220.

items.stem: A puddle of water on a windowsill disappears after a hot afternoon. Which change of state has taken place?
options: Liquid water has frozen into solid ice
Solid ice has melted into liquid water
Liquid water has turned into water vapour
Water vapour has condensed into liquid water
items.explanation: The heat gives the water enough energy to evaporate, so the liquid changes into water vapour in the air instead of freezing or condensing.

items.stem: Wheels are fitted to a heavy suitcase instead of letting it be dragged along the floor. Why is pulling it with wheels easier?
options: Rolling increases friction between two surfaces
Rolling creates less friction than sliding
items.explanation: Rolling friction is much smaller than sliding friction, so wheels make the suitcase easier to pull, although they never remove friction completely.

items.stem: A book is lifted from the floor and placed on a high shelf. Compared with before, the book now has more of which form of energy?
items.explanation: Lifting the book raises it higher above the ground, so it stores more gravitational potential energy because of its greater height.

items.stem: Which material allows light to pass through so that objects behind it can be seen clearly?
items.explanation: Clear glass is transparent, so light passes through it and objects behind it stay visible, while the other materials block or absorb the light.

items.stem: Four identical bulbs are connected in series in a circuit. One bulb breaks and the circuit is broken. What happens to the other three bulbs?
options: They continue to glow as before
Only one of them still glows
items.explanation: A series circuit has only one path for the current, so a break caused by one bulb stops the current and every other bulb goes out.

items.stem: Which of these objects will be attracted by a bar magnet?
items.explanation: Iron is a magnetic material, so an iron nail is attracted to the magnet, whereas wood, copper and rubber are not magnetic.

items.stem: One end of a metal rod is held in a flame. Which method carries most of the heat along the rod to the cooler end?
items.explanation: Heat travels along solid metal by conduction as vibrating particles pass energy to their neighbours, while convection needs a fluid and radiation needs no medium.

items.stem: Which part of a plant absorbs water and dissolved minerals from the soil?
items.explanation: Roots spread out through the soil and take in water and minerals, while leaves make food and the flower and fruit take part in reproduction.

items.stem: In the life cycle of a butterfly, which stage follows the larva stage?
items.explanation: A butterfly develops as egg, larva, pupa and adult, so the stage after the caterpillar larva is the pupa, in which the body changes form.

items.stem: In one food chain, grass is eaten by zebras and zebras are eaten by lions. Which organism is the producer?
options: Both the zebra and the lion
items.explanation: Producers make their own food using sunlight, and grass is the only organism in this chain that does so, while the animals are consumers.

items.stem: Which organ pumps blood around the human body?
items.explanation: The heart contracts to push blood through the blood vessels to every part of the body, whereas the lungs, liver and stomach each carry out different jobs.

items.stem: What is the basic unit of structure and function in all living things?
items.explanation: All living organisms are built from cells, which carry out the processes of life, while atoms and molecules are the units of non-living matter.

items.stem: In which organ does most of the chemical digestion of food and the absorption of nutrients take place?
items.explanation: Juices from the bile and pancreas break food down in the small intestine, whose lining absorbs the nutrients, so most digestion and absorption happen there.

items.stem: Which waste material is removed from the blood by the kidneys?
items.explanation: The kidneys filter urea out of the blood and pass it out as urine, while carbon dioxide leaves through the lungs and undigested food leaves as faeces.

items.stem: Aisha wants to find out how the height of a stick affects the length of its shadow. Which factor should she change during her investigation?
options: The shape of the measuring ruler
items.explanation: The height of the stick is the variable being tested, so only it may be changed, while the light source, ground surface and measuring tool must be kept the same.

items.stem: Choose the correct measure word to complete this Chinese sentence. 我买了三____书送给弟弟。
items.explanation: Chinese uses 本 as the measure word for books, so 三本书 means three books, while 张 suits flat objects such as paper and 条 suits long thin objects.

items.stem: Choose the pinyin reading with the correct tones for the Chinese word 学校, which means school.
items.explanation: 学 is read with the second tone and 校 with the fourth tone, so xuéxiào is correct, while the other options give the wrong tone to one or both characters.

items.stem: Which meaning best matches the Chinese idiom 一心一意, which describes how a pupil works towards a goal?
options: Giving up halfway through a task
Changing one's mind again and again
Ruin caused by adding unnecessary detail
items.explanation: 一心一意 speaks of one heart and one mind, so it means wholehearted concentration, while the other three meanings belong to idioms such as 三心二意 and 半途而废.

items.stem: Choose the Chinese word opposite in meaning to 认真, which means to do something carefully and seriously.
items.explanation: 认真 means careful and earnest and 马虎 means careless, which is its opposite, while 仔细 means careful, 努力 means hardworking and 勇敢 means brave.

items.stem: Complete the Chinese sentence with the correct particle. 他跑____很快，在比赛中得了第一名。
items.explanation: After a verb, the particle 得 introduces a complement that describes how the action was done, so 跑得很快 is correct, while 的 and 地 are used before nouns and verbs.

items.stem: Which Chinese sentence is written in the correct word order so that it reads naturally?
items.explanation: Chinese places the time expression before the verb, so the first sentence puts the time before 起床 and reads naturally, while the others move the verb to the wrong place.

items.stem: Read the sentence. 小明认真复习，结果一次考试就通过了两科，真是一箭双雕。What idea does the idiom 一箭双雕 express?
options: Two results achieved with a single effort
Two arrows that miss the target
items.explanation: 一箭双雕 means shooting two hawks with one arrow, so it describes gaining two results from one action, which fits passing two subjects through one period of revision.

items.stem: What is the meaning of the Malay phrase terima kasih, which people often say to a helper?
items.explanation: Terima kasih is the standard Malay expression of thanks, while the other three phrases are greetings or requests that do not thank the listener.

items.stem: Choose the Malay word that means small, the opposite of besar.
items.explanation: Kecil means small and is the opposite of besar, which means large, while tinggi means tall, panjang means long and berat means heavy.

items.stem: Complete the Malay sentence with the correct word. Siti pergi ke sekolah ____ basikal setiap pagi.
items.explanation: Dengan means by or with and is used with a means of transport in this sentence, while daripada means from, kepada means to and tentang means about.

items.stem: In the Mother Tongue Languages oral examination, what do candidates do before the stimulus-based conversation begins?
items.explanation: The oral paper opens with a reading aloud section, after which the examiner asks questions for the stimulus-based conversation, so candidates read a passage first.

items.stem: Why do Mother Tongue Language lessons include idioms and proverbs from the culture?
options: They are the only part of the written paper
They replace the need to learn grammar rules
They show how a community expresses its ideas and values
They help students write in English faster
items.explanation: Idioms and proverbs carry the values and images of the community, so learning them helps pupils express ideas naturally and understand the culture behind the language.

items.stem: Read the Chinese sentence. 妈妈常常鼓励我，遇到困难不要放弃。What does 鼓励 mean in this sentence?
items.explanation: The sentence tells the child not to give up when facing difficulty, so 鼓励 means to encourage or urge on, while scolding, forgiving and allowing do not fit.

items.stem: Which of these is offered as a Mother Tongue Language in the PSLE alongside Chinese and Malay?
items.explanation: Tamil is one of the Mother Tongue Languages offered in Singapore schools alongside Chinese and Malay, while the other three are not part of the PSLE Mother Tongue Languages.

items.stem: The Chinese word 图书馆 means library. Which character tells you that the word names a place or a building?
items.explanation: 馆 is the character for a hall or establishment, as in 饭馆 for an eating place, so it signals a building, while 图 and 书 refer to pictures and books.
